# 预览取消验证

正文保留。

![预览图片.svg](asset:4a804498-5faf-438d-aa30-108fafb1a769)
requestFault: First two preview responses forward real server headers plus their first byte, holding the rest for up to 60 seconds; all other traffic goes to the actual service.
observations: Initial manual browser steps were farther apart than the 15-second request deadline, so those first two close events only prove timeout recovery.

The second browser pass grouped input and save actions after 1.2-second debounce waits in one UI call. Both incomplete bodies closed in under three seconds, before the normal request deadline; the third preview completed.
limitations: The local proxy held responses after actual parsing completed; cancelling the client read does not establish interruption of synchronous server parsing.
No native Tauri window or audio/video playback was rerun.
cancellationDurationOrigin: Elapsed from the proxy first-byte event to response close.
